infinite-series.def: A sum with infinitely many terms, $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n = a_1 + a_2 + \cdots$ It converges to $S$ when its partial sums approach $S$, and diverges when they have no finite limit.

partial-sum.def: The sum of the first $n$ terms of a series, $S_n = a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$. The partial sums form a sequence whose limit, if it exists, is the sum of the series.
